author: The Infographics Show
description:
What happens if you fall 130 feet beneath the Moon’s surface and your spacesuit starts leaking oxygen?

In this survival simulation set in 2038, an astronaut exploring the Moon’s Marius Hills suddenly falls through the surface into an enormous underground lava tube. Trapped beneath solid volcanic rock, surrounded by complete darkness, and cut off from radio communication, survival becomes a race against time. The astronaut has just 24 hours of oxygen, a damaged spacesuit, and no obvious way back to the lunar surface.
This hour-by-hour simulation explores the terrifying challenges of surviving inside a lunar lava tube, from navigating unstable basalt formations and discovering underground ice to dealing with equipment failures, oxygen loss, and the dangers of exposure to the vacuum of space. As the spacesuit's damaged boot begins losing pressure, every step becomes a gamble. A possible exit lies miles away, but reaching it means crossing unknown terrain and climbing toward the surface
title: Trapped Inside a Lunar Lava Tube (Survival Simulation) - (HOUR BY HOUR)
